Incorrect Charges: If a customer reasonably and in good faith disputes an invoice or a portion of an invoice, the customer must notify skyfi.vn of the dispute within 10 business days of receiving the invoice. The notification must include information about why the customer believes the amount charged is incorrect as well as, if possible, the amount that the customer believes is owed.

The customer has deleted the eSIM and wants to reinstall it.
The customer's device does not support eSIM.
The customer's phone is network locked.
The eSIM has expired (The expiration date is stated in the order confirmation email).
The country you are visiting has force majeure circumstances (including but not limited to natural disasters, earthquakes, epidemics, fires, wars, strikes, riots, changes in local legal policies, changes in government...).
The network infrastructure of the travel countries has issues, is not yet stable.
The customer does not proactively contact skyfi.vn when an eSIM issue occurs.

Please note that the above refund policy will apply. Customers may be required to provide additional information to support their refund request, depending on the nature of the issue, such as screenshots of device settings for technical issues, an explanation of why the amount billed is incorrect and if possible, an estimate of how much the customer believes is owed.

iosInstructions.installation:
1. Go to Settings > Cellular > Add eSIM or Set Up Cellular Service > Use QR Code on your device.

2. Scan the QR code or take a screenshot (available up to iOS 17.3), tap "Open Image", select this code from camera roll, tap "Next", then tap "Continue" twice and wait a moment. Your eSIM will connect to the network, this may take a few minutes, then tap "Done".

3. Choose a label for your new eSIM package.

4. Select "Primary" for your default SIM, then tap "Continue".

5. Select the "Primary" SIM you want to use with iMessage and FaceTime for Apple ID, then tap "Continue".

6. Select the new eSIM package for cellular data, then tap "Continue".
iosInstructions.manualInstallation:
1. Go to Settings > Cellular > Add eSIM or Set Up Cellular Service > Enter Details Manually.

2. Enter the SM-DP+ Address and Activation Code provided by your carrier.

3. Tap "Next" and wait for the eSIM to download and activate.

4. Choose a label for your new eSIM package.

5. Select "Primary" for your default SIM, then tap "Continue".

6. Select the "Primary" SIM you want to use with iMessage and FaceTime for Apple ID, then tap "Continue".

7. Select the new eSIM package for cellular data, then tap "Continue".
iosInstructions.networkEnable:
1. Go to "Cellular Data", then select the eSIM that was just downloaded to your device. Turn on the "Turn on this line" switch, then select your new eSIM package for cellular data.

2. Tap "Choose Network", disable the "Automatic" switch, then manually select the supported network if your eSIM has connected to the wrong network.

3. Turn on the "Data Roaming" switch for your new eSIM package.

androidInstructions.installation:
1. Go to Settings > Network & Internet > Mobile Network > Add Carrier or SIM Cards > Download a SIM instead.

2. Scan the QR code or enter the activation details manually.

3. Wait for the eSIM to download and activate on your device.

4. Choose a name for your new eSIM line.

5. Select which SIM to use for calls, SMS, and mobile data.
androidInstructions.manualInstallation:
1. Go to Settings > Network & Internet > Mobile Network > Add Carrier or SIM Cards > Enter Details Manually.

2. Enter the SM-DP+ Server Address and Activation Code provided by your carrier.

3. Tap "Add" and wait for the eSIM to download and activate.

4. Choose a name for your new eSIM line.

5. Select which SIM to use for calls, SMS, and mobile data.
androidInstructions.networkEnable:
1. Go to Settings > Network & Internet > Mobile Network and select your new eSIM.

2. Turn on "Use SIM" and select it for mobile data if needed.

3. Enable "Roaming" for your new eSIM when traveling.

4. Manually select network if automatic connection fails.

faq3.question: How to install eSIM?
faq3.answer:
Step 1: Open the Settings app on your phone.
Step 2: Go to Cellular or Mobile Data.
Step 3: Select Add Cellular Plan or Add Data Plan.
Step 4: Scan the QR code provided by SkyFi or enter the activation code manually.
Step 5: Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the installation.

faq4.question: After installing eSIM
faq4.answer: After installing eSIM, users can check the status of the eSIM in the Settings app under Cellular or Mobile Data.\nUsers can also manage their eSIM settings, such as turning it on or off, changing the default line for calls and messages, and more.

faq5.question: How to check installed ICCID?
faq5.answer: To check the installed ICCID, go to Settings > Cellular or Mobile Data > Cellular Plans. Select the eSIM you want to check, and the ICCID will be displayed in the details.

faq6.question: How to check APN settings and change APN?
faq6.answer: To check APN settings, go to Settings > Cellular or Mobile Data > Cellular Plans. Select the eSIM you want to check, and look for the APN settings.\nTo change the APN, tap on the APN field and enter the new APN information provided by your eSIM provider.

faq7.question: Troubleshooting
faq7.answer:
If you encounter issues with your eSIM, try the following steps:
1. Restart your phone.
2. Ensure you have a stable internet connection.
3. Check if your phone's software is up to date.
4. If the issue persists, contact SkyFi support for assistance.

faq8.question: iMessage and Facetime
faq8.answer:
To use iMessage and FaceTime with your eSIM, ensure that you have activated the eSIM and have a stable internet connection.
Go to Settings > Messages and turn on iMessage.
For FaceTime, go to Settings > FaceTime and turn it on.
You can choose to use your eSIM number for both services.

faq9.question: Wifi Hotspot /mobile data sharing
faq9.answer:
To share your mobile data via Wi-Fi hotspot, go to Settings > Cellular or Mobile Data > Personal Hotspot.
Turn on Allow Others to Join.
You can set a password for the hotspot if desired.
Other devices can connect to your hotspot using the Wi-Fi password you set.

faq10.question: When can eSIM be removed from the phone?
faq10.answer: eSIM can be removed from the phone at any time. However, please note that most eSIMs can only be installed once. If you remove the eSIM from your device, you will not be able to reinstall it. Make sure to back up any important data before removing the eSIM.
